The '''''Locus''''' was a survey [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] that operated during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
In [[90 BBY/Legends|90 BBY]], the ''Locus'' and the survey vessel ''[[Ardent Virtue]]'' were sent to the [[Luire system]] on a Republic-funded expedition to observe the system's five gas giants. However, in [[87 BBY/Legends|87 BBY]], the ''Locus'' lost power while carrying out an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] scan of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]], and crash-landed onto the world. The ''Ardent Virtue'' attempted to rescue the crew of the ''Locus'', but was unable to contact them.

A [[86 BBY/Legends|year later]], a landing party from the ''Ardent Virtue'' discovered the wreckage of the ''Locus'', but were unable to find any of the ship's surviving crew members. The settlement [[Locus (settlement)|Locus]] was eventually constructed around the craft's remains.
